annotations.title: Get FRC Team Season Stats (Single Team-Year)

description: Get one team's performance summary for one specific FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) season. Returns the team's EPA breakdown for that year (start, pre-playoffs, end, max, mean, ranks/percentiles), win/loss/tie record and win rate, count and list of events attended, district points, and award totals. Use this to answer "how did team 2056 do in 2023?", "what was team 254's peak EPA in 2018?", or "how many events did team 1114 attend in 2024?". Requires both team number (integer, no prefix) and a 4-digit year >= 2002. For multi-team or multi-year browsing, use get_team_years.
name: get_team_year
